Please solve this issue: We are building Quizzy, a live quiz app for conference talks, as a Ruby on Rails application. Start in the `/app` Git repository. It has no app yet. Install all dependencies while you work: we verify the app without network access.

Feel free to store any design notes/insights that could be useful for future steps in the docs/ folder.

How we run the app:

- We start it with `bin/serve` from the project root and these environment variables: `RAILS_ENV=production`, `PORT=3000`, `SECRET_KEY_BASE`, `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME`, `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD`.

- `GET /up` responds with `200` when the app is ready.
- The app keeps all its data under `storage/`. It must not call external services.

Our QA auto-tests drive the app in a browser and rely on the labels in quotes in each task. Keep them exactly as written, as visible text, a <label>, a placeholder, or an aria-label.

The QA auto-tests also expect:

- Each item of a list (a quiz, a question) sits in its own list item or table row, with its buttons and links inside it.
- Switches are checkboxes (a styled switch is fine if a real checkbox sits under it).
- Confirmations use the browser's native `confirm()` dialog.

Talks have tight schedules, so moderators asked for a timer.

The quiz settings get the time per question: the "Timer minutes" and "Timer seconds" fields (numbers, 0 by default). 0 minutes and 0 seconds means no timer.

With a timer:

- The moderator's big screen shows a countdown in the M:SS format (for example, "1:30" or "0:05") while a question is open. Players don't see the timer.
- The countdown starts when the question opens. Reloading the page doesn't restart it.
- At 0:00, the question finishes by itself, as if the moderator clicked "Finish". The moderator can still click "Finish" earlier.

The timer is a setting of this Quizzy, so it is not part of the export format.

    @json_string = json_string.to_s

  def save
    @errors = []

      @errors << "Quiz JSON can't be blank"

  def validate_payload(data)
    raw_title = data["title"]
    if !raw_title.is_a?(String) || raw_title.strip.empty?
      @errors << "Title can't be blank"
    end

    raw_questions = data["questions"]
    if !data.key?("questions") || !raw_questions.is_a?(Array)
      @errors << "Questions must be an array"
      return
    end

    raw_questions.each_with_index do |q_data, q_idx|

  def validate_question(q_data, q_num)
    unless q_data.is_a?(Hash)
      @errors << "Question #{q_num} must be a JSON object"
      return

    q_text = q_data["text"]
    if !q_text.is_a?(String) || q_text.strip.empty?

    end

    if q_data.key?("active") && ![ true, false ].include?(q_data["active"])

    raw_options = q_data["options"]
    if !q_data.key?("options") || !raw_options.is_a?(Array)
      @errors << "Question #{q_num}: options must be an array"
      return
    end

    raw_options.each_with_index do |opt_data, opt_idx|
      validate_option(opt_data, q_num, opt_idx + 1)
    end

    if raw_options.size < 2
      @errors << "Question #{q_num}: Add at least two options"

      end
      true
    end
  end

  def end_game!
    with_lock do
      return false if finished?

      update!(
        status: "finished",
        finished_at: Time.current,
        version: version + 1
      )
      true
    end
  end

  def join_player!(name)
    trimmed = name.to_s.strip
    return nil if trimmed.blank?

    with_lock do
      return :finished if finished?

      player = players.create!(name: trimmed)
      update!(version: version + 1)
      player
    end
  end

  def record_answer!(player:, game_question_id:, game_option_id:)
    return :closed if player.nil?

    with_lock do
      return :closed unless question_open?

      question = current_question
      return :closed unless question && question.id == game_question_id.to_i

      option = question.game_options.find_by(id: game_option_id)
      return :invalid unless option

      answer = answers.find_or_initialize_by(player: player, game_question: question)
      if answer.new_record? || answer.game_option_id != option.id
        answer.game_option = option
        answer.answered_at = Time.current
        answer.save!
        update!(version: version + 1)
      end
      answer
    end
  end

  def leaderboard
    questions_by_id = game_questions.index_by(&:id)
    all_players = players.order(:created_at, :id).to_a
    correct_answers_by_player = answers
      .includes(:game_option)
      .select { |answer| answer.game_option.correct? }
      .group_by(&:player_id)

    scored = all_players.map do |player|
      player_answers = correct_answers_by_player[player.id] || []
      points = player_answers.size
      total_time = player_answers.sum do |answer|
        question = questions_by_id[answer.game_question_id]
        opened = question&.opened_at || started_at || question&.created_at || answer.created_at
        picked = answer.answered_at || answer.updated_at || opened
        [ picked - opened, 0.0 ].max
      end

      {
        player: player,
        points: points,
        total_time: total_time
      }
    end

    sorted = scored.sort_by do |row|
      [ -row[:points], row[:total_time], row[:player].created_at, row[:player].id ]
    end

    sorted.each_with_index.map do |row, idx|
      LeaderboardEntry.new(
        player: row[:player],
        place: idx + 1,
        points: row[:points],
        total_time: row[:total_time],
        winner: row[:player].winner?
      )
    end
  end

  def pick_top_winners!
    with_lock do
      return false unless finished?

      winner_ids = leaderboard
        .select { |entry| entry.points.positive? }
        .first(winners_count)
        .map(&:player_id)

      apply_winners!(winner_ids)
      true
    end
  end

  def draw_winners!
    with_lock do
      return false unless finished?

      eligible = leaderboard.select { |entry| entry.points.positive? }
      winner_ids = if eligible.size <= winners_count
        eligible.map(&:player_id)
      else
        nth_points = eligible[winners_count - 1].points
        guaranteed = eligible.select { |entry| entry.points > nth_points }
        remaining = winners_count - guaranteed.size
        tied_pool = eligible.select { |entry| entry.points == nth_points }

        (guaranteed + tied_pool.sample(remaining)).map(&:player_id)
      end

      apply_winners!(winner_ids)
      true
    end
  end

  def reset_winners!
    with_lock do
      return false unless finished?

      apply_winners!([])
      true
    end
  end

  private

  def apply_winners!(winner_ids)
    transaction do
      players.update_all(winner: false)
      players.where(id: winner_ids).update_all(winner: true) if winner_ids.any?
      players.reset
      update!(version: version + 1)
    end
  end

## Question Timer (Release 4)
- **Quiz Settings (`quizzes.timer_minutes`, `quizzes.timer_seconds`)**:
  - Both default to `0` (`>= 0`, integer), labeled `"Timer minutes"` and `"Timer seconds"`. `0` minutes and `0` seconds disables the timer.

  - Excluded from `Quiz#export_payload` (`QuizImport` leaves timer at `0:00`).
- **Countdown & Persistence Across Reloads**:
  - `Game#question_deadline` computes `current_question.opened_at + question_timer_seconds.seconds`; `Game#timer_remaining_ms` and `Game#timer_remaining_seconds` derive remaining time from the server timestamp so page reloads continue smoothly without restarting the countdown.

  - Passing `expected_question_id` and locking the `Game` row ensures clicking `"Finish"` early or concurrent expiration triggers only a single clean transition and broadcast.
